summary.text: Ty Mathews is a Republican state representative who has represented Ohio House District 83 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An Army National Guard infantry officer, he previously worked as a legislative and policy assistant in the Ohio Treasurer's Office.

paragraphs.text: Mathews earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Cedarville University in 2018 and a master's degree in executive leadership from Liberty University in 2023.
He served as an infantry officer with the Army National Guard and worked as a legislative and policy assistant with the Ohio Treasurer's Office.
Mathews defeated incumbent Jon Cross in the March 19, 2024 Republican primary and Democrat Sheila Coressel in the November 5, 2024 general election.
He serves on the Development, Natural Resources, Veterans and Military Development (vice chair), and Technology and Innovation committees.
Sheila Coressel is again the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
